name: Elaine Griffith
occupation: Niobrara County commissioner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)

background: Elaine Griffith is a Niobrara County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. She won the November 2022 general election, and the official commissioners page lists her as a member. Incoming commissioner Kevin H. Baars takes office in January 2027.
